meta.name: pin-audit
meta.description: Use when checking pin graph health. Runs lib/pins/audit to detect dangling relations, duplicates, invalid entities, stale entries, and orphans, then presents a ranked report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计 pin graph 健康并生成排名报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的项目依赖 pin graph 并需要定期检查数据完整性
copy.tagline_en: Audit pin graph health and generate ranked report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project relies on pin graph and needs regular data integrity checks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude可以执行只读的pin知识图谱健康检查，检测悬空关系、重复实体、无效实体、过期条目和孤立节点，并生成按严重程度排序的报告，不修改任何数据。
howto.when: 当用户要求检查pin图健康或进行pin审计时触发。

say.note: 运行只读检查，报告所有问题。

say.text: 查看pin图是否有过期条目。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can run a read-only health check on the pin knowledge graph, detecting dangling relations, duplicates, invalid entities, stale entries, and orphans, then present a ranked report without modifying any data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to check pin graph health or perform a pin audit.

say_en.note: Runs read‑only check and reports all issues.

say_en.text: Check for dangling relations in pins.
Show stale entries in the pin graph.
